item.title: MCP Streamable HTTP Production Guide 2026: stdio vs Streamable HTTP
item.description: The Model Context Protocol has surpassed 97 million monthly SDK downloads and 81,000 GitHub stars as of April 2026. 78% of enterprise AI teams report at least one MCP-backed agent in production. The transport layer decision — stdio vs Streamable HTTP — determines whether your MCP server is a local dev tool or a production service that scales across teams and organizational boundaries. This guide covers when to use each transport, how to authenticate Streamable HTTP servers with OAuth 2.1, and platform-specific deployment recipes for Cloudflare Workers, AWS ECS, and Kubernetes.
